description: This file is a controller class for managing subscription-related actions in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles listing, viewing, editing, deleting, and logging of subscriptions, including related entities such as orders and histories.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription actions within the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, viewing, editing, and logging.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the subscription list page, setting up view data, and handling filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve and output the subscription list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs the list data for subscriptions, including filters, sorting, pagination, and output rendering.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including related customer, order, address, logs, and history.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Provides an API endpoint to trigger storefront API calls related to subscriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscriptions after permission validation.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Outputs the history of a subscription.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history entries for a specific subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a subscription, with status change and comment.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Outputs associated order data for a subscription.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of orders linked to a subscription.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs logs related to a subscription.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves paginated logs for a subscription.
